description: Production-harden the quality workflow integration and RR7 migration cleanup by removing fake runners, wiring real production hooks, hardening Convex handlers and REST routes, fixing WAL/resume/idempotency gaps, and closing weak tests and frontend defects identified in the 24-hour commit review.
deviation_notes: All 6 phases implemented without deferrals. Key changes: (1) AutoRunner threads qualityWorkflowHooks, fake runner removed, loadEffectiveQualityProfile fixed. (2) Full profile snapshots stored, append-only audit, setTaskOverride validation fixed, v.any() replaced with typed validator. (3) Required non-applicable stages fail the run, skipped stages preserved in logs, lastResult! removed, evaluateQualityRecovery handles maxAttempts<=0. (4) Idempotency key added to appendStageAttempt, planQualityRunResume uses typed API, ResumeStage.applicability typed. (5) Hardcoded project slugs removed, stageKind from request body, aria-status→data-status, fake 'unknown' option removed, useQualityProfile surfaces errors, QualityOperationsPanel accepts projectSlug, Prettier fixed, router-inventory test path fixed, inventory.md settings paths aligned. (6) All 1762 pivot tests pass, 42 frontend tests pass, typecheck clean.
